 Experience a 'breathtaking' Christmas show as top Michael Bublé tribute act comes to Cirencester
 Sure to bring big festive vibes, an internationally renowned Michael Bublé tribute act is bringing his 'breathtaking' live show to Cirencester's Ingleside House this December 2026 – just in time for Christmas!
By Jake Chown 
 |  
Published Wednesday 18 November 2026 
 Michael Bublé tribute act Mike Appleton has performed onboard cruise lines, at holiday resorts and corporate events across the world – and even with the man himself at a sold-out O2 Arena in London in 2019. 
 Friday 18 December 2026 
 Add to calendar 
 Croon the night away to festive big band classics after sitting down to a delicious three-course Christmas dinner, as The Michael Bublé Experience comes to Ingleside House in Cirencester .
 What to expect from The Michael Bublé Experience at Ingleside House in Cirencester? 
 A throwback to the stateside crooners of the 50s and 60s like Frank Sinatra, Bing Crosby and Andy Williams, Michael Bublé has long been associated with Christmas – with his recordings of big band yuletide classics a staple of festive playlists in households across the country.
 And kicking off Christmas week with a show packed with renditions of his best known recordings, singer Mike Appleton brings his internationally renowned tribute, The Michael Bublé Experience, to Cirencester's Ingleside House.
 Described as an 'authentic and breathtaking' tribute show, featuring all the songs, moves, the voice, and the look of the man himself, Ingleside says guests will experience the songbook of Michael Bublé 'like never before'.
 Providing the full cabaret experience Ingleside House is known for, guests will also sit down to a three-course Christmas set menu, before the entertainment starts.
 When is The Michael Bublé Experience at Ingleside House?
 The Michael Bublé Experience at Ingleside House takes place on Friday 18 December 2026, with doors opening at 6pm, and food being served from 7pm. 
 How to book The Michael Bublé Experience at Ingleside House
 Tickets cost between £55 and £75. To book, visit barntheatre.org.uk/entertainment-at-ingleside .
